about_the_game:
Cellular, old-school, sci-fi, retro-FPS action inspired by Quake II, Battletanx, and even (too a MUCH smaller extent), Osmosis Jones and Army Men: Sarge's Heroes! 7 weapons with each unique function! Secrets galore in virtually every level to collect! Fight through many ranks of the Crimson Viruses and their vehicles, as well as the nasty wildlife in underliquid swimming areas! Listen to awesome heavy metal and synth music from White Bat while you're ramming Viruses with total carnage while driving an auto-chariot!

Now with DirectX 12 Software Raytracing!

[STORY]
The Gene-Virus War has just begun and the Genes are already losing. When the Viruses attacked, they took us them by surprise – ravaged their great cities with airborne diseases and viral strikes, penetrating through the Immune System’s defenses, slaughtering everyone in their path. No man, woman, nor child was spared. In a matter of hours, the entire organic system they know as the Organos, was conquered by the Viroids. As you and your squadron prepare to land in your capital city Genosyth, an attack by the notorious Crimson Viruses has destroyed your dropship, knocking you off-board and obliterating everyone else on board. As yo wake you, you witness nothing but a massacre before your very eyes. Far as you are concerned, you are the last of the Genoids – a race and civilization of cyan blood cells that once thrived peacefully throughout the Organos. As the sole-surviving Gene-Soldier, it is time to carry out your mission and vendetta: Fight your way through hordes of Viruses in search for survivors and to avenge your fellow cells against whoever is responsible for this horrific genocide.
_

This DLC is automatically bundled with JSC, however you can buy this standalone version individually here if you don't wish to buy the entire collection.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shadel Model 5
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 886 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shadel Model 6
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: Software Raytracing Support
